neighbours.label: nouns naming a process or its use in technical writing (' development', ' application', processing)
fire: Current status and development trends of laser welding technology in Europe.
The rapid development of solid-state batteries could reshape the car industry.
New imaging sensors may greatly expand the application of robotic surgery.
Chapter 3 reviews the development of thin-film coating methods since 1990.
The application of machine learning to crop monitoring is still at an early stage.
Engineers studied the development of cracks in the turbine blades under load.
This report covers the application of ceramic coatings to cutting tools.
Funding for the development of quieter jet engines rose sharply last year.
quiet: Current prices and market share of laser welding equipment in Europe.
The high cost of solid-state batteries could reshape the car industry.
New imaging sensors may greatly reduce the size of robotic surgery tools.
Chapter 3 reviews the weight and colour of thin-film coating materials since 1990.
The price of machine learning hardware for crop monitoring is still very high.
Engineers studied the shape of the turbine blades under load.
This report covers the hardness of ceramic coatings on cutting tools.
Funding for quieter jet engines and new airport buildings rose sharply last year.

notes: Card: top peaks ' Development', ' development', ' application', and CJK/Korean equivalents (処理 processing, 진행 progression, 製作 making, 使用 use) in technical text; the output promotes ' method', ' process', ' manner', ' way'. Near misses keep the technical topic and swap in object or property nouns.
